name: Vaani Warm Intelligence Design System
description: Design token specification for the Vaani AI front office platform, embodying 'Warm Intelligence'—an authoritative, deeply Indian, precision-engineered visual identity.

warm.description: Base warm paper canvas for editorial clarity and human warmth

subtle.description: Secondary tint for recessed panels and table headers

primary.description: Deep spruce ink for authoritative headings and high-contrast body

secondary.description: Earthy forest tone for supporting descriptions and metadata

muted.description: Slate-spruce for captions, timestamps, and subtle borders

inverse.description: Text rendered over deep spruce or dark backgrounds

jade.description: Primary emerald jade brand voltage for CTAs and focus states

jade_dark.description: Deep forest gradient stop for brand tiles and buttons

jade_deep.description: Deepest spruce for night backgrounds and terminal panels

jade_subtle.description: Soft jade wash for active chips and selected states

terracotta.description: Terracotta earthenware accent for urgency, recovered revenue, and energy

terracotta_subtle.description: Soft peach-terracotta background wash for revenue badges

gold.description: Temple brass/gold accent for trust seals, morning briefs, and ratings

gold_subtle.description: Soft temple cream wash for verified guarantees

success.description: Positive state for confirmed bookings and passing tests

danger.description: Critical alerts, cancellations, and handoff escalations

warning.description: Approaching timeout or pending staff action

light.description: Subtle card dividing hairline on light surfaces

strong.description: Defined boundary hairline for interactive inputs

dark.description: Luminous hairline rule on dark spruce surfaces
